title: SillyMinecrafter 1K
description: A simple, vanilla-like 1.8 PVP texture pack!
body:
My 1K subscribers milestone texture pack! the pack is focused on 1.8 PvP, and includes features like:
- Short Swords
- Low Fire
- Better True-to-Vanilla PvP textures
- Better GUI (hotbar, inventory)
- Outlined Wool Overlay
- Visible Armor Overlay
- Better Crit Particles

Pictures in the Gallery section!
subscribe to my [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@SillyMinecrafterr)! :)
